status: Editorial sketches only; not enabled in live dialogue.

scenarios.title: Gift refusal
scenarios.statement: I will not disclose my gift.
scenarios.note: The decision is to refuse. No role, reason for secrecy, or promise to reveal later is supplied.

scenarios.title: Routine alibi
scenarios.statement: I stayed home all last night.
scenarios.note: A claimed alibi, not certified truth. No sleeping, visitors, activity, or independent proof is supplied.

scenarios.title: Firsthand report
scenarios.prompt: Who did you see yesterday evening?
scenarios.statement: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
scenarios.note: Rowan is a fictional visitor used for calibration, so nobody reports seeing themselves. No route, action, motive, companion, or finer time is supplied.

scenarios.title: The same report under doubt
scenarios.statement: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
scenarios.note: The player has expressed doubt. The speaker maintains the same account; no new proof, certainty change, or counter-accusation is authorized.

agnes.direction: Invites understanding; warmth without an affectionate address on every line.
agnes.gift_refusal: I'm keeping that to myself, love. I hope you'll understand.
agnes.alibi: I was home all last night. Nothing more to tell you there.
agnes.report: Oh, yes. I did see Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
agnes.challenged_report: All right, let's talk it through. I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. What troubles you about that?

bart.direction: States the minimum and stops; no habitual counterattack.
bart.report: Saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
bart.challenged_report: Rowan. Tavern. Yesterday evening. That's my account.

constance.direction: Considers the propriety of the inquiry and the responsibility of an assertion.
constance.gift_refusal: I shall not disclose my gift merely because you ask.
constance.alibi: I remained at home throughout last night.
constance.report: As I recall, Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening.
constance.challenged_report: I stand by my account: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. If you object, state your grounds.

dorian.direction: Worries about how his words sound, without becoming uncertain of the observation.
dorian.gift_refusal: I'd rather not say. That sounds evasive. Sorry, but I'm still not saying.
dorian.alibi: Home all last night. I know how convenient that sounds, but it's what happened.
dorian.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. That's all I meant to say.
dorian.challenged_report: Have I explained it badly? I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. No, that was clear enough. I stand by it.

edda.direction: Grounds the exchange in a plain answer; occasional understatement, no ornamental folk sayings.
edda.gift_refusal: I'm keeping my gift to myself. We can still talk.
edda.alibi: Home all last night. Nothing complicated about it.
edda.report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. Saw them myself.
edda.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Worrying at the answer won't change it.

fenwick.direction: Enjoys delivering the reveal; the performance stays shorter than a story and supplies no scenery.
fenwick.gift_refusal: Ah, you'd have me give the whole tale away. My gift stays with me.
fenwick.alibi: My grand adventure last night? Home, the whole night. A poor tale, I grant you.
fenwick.report: And who should I see at the tavern yesterday evening? Rowan.
fenwick.challenged_report: You wound me! Rowan, at the tavern yesterday evening. I saw them, whatever you think of the telling.

greta.direction: Tests the questioner's entitlement; sharper than Bart, focused on trust rather than efficiency.
greta.gift_refusal: Why do you need to know? My gift stays my business.
greta.alibi: Home all last night. That's your answer.
greta.report: Rowan. I saw them at the tavern yesterday evening.
greta.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Are you questioning what I saw, or just questioning me?

hollis.direction: Examines scope and definitions; precision never invents a finer location or time.
hollis.gift_refusal: I understand the question. I am declining to answer it.
hollis.alibi: At home throughout last night. Throughout is the relevant part.
hollis.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. An observation, you understand, not an explanation.
hollis.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Your doubt is an objection to the account, but not yet a reason to revise it.

isolde.direction: Fears what testimony may do to someone; cushions the consequence, not the fact.
isolde.gift_refusal: Please, let me keep my gift to myself.
isolde.alibi: I stayed home all last night. Please believe me.
isolde.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Please, don't take that as an accusation.
isolde.challenged_report: I don't want to argue. But I did see Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Please don't ask me to take that back.

jory.direction: Short bursts reach for the next useful question; eagerness rather than Bart's closure.
jory.gift_refusal: Not saying what my gift is. Something else?
jory.report: Rowan. Tavern, yesterday evening. Saw them. Anything else?
jory.challenged_report: But I saw Rowan! Tavern. Yesterday evening. Which bit do you want again?

kiran.direction: Turns the question back with an easy smile; protects his own affairs without inventing a reason.
kiran.gift_refusal: Straight to my gift? You do skip the pleasantries. I'll keep that one to myself.
kiran.alibi: Home all last night. You were hoping for a better story, weren't you?
kiran.report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. I saw them. There, a question I can oblige you on.
kiran.challenged_report: You did ask for my account. Must it pass an audition? I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.

lian.direction: Brevity is practical triage; redirects toward a useful check rather than testing personal submission.
lian.gift_refusal: Not sharing my gift. Ask what I can verify.
lian.alibi: Home all last night. What else needs checking?
lian.report: Rowan was at the tavern yesterday evening. That's what I saw.
lian.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Tell me what needs checking; repeating it won't help.

merrin.direction: Dramatizes the burden of the conversation, then lands on the concrete detail; no prophetic facts.
merrin.gift_refusal: Must we drag every private thing into the light? My gift is staying private.
merrin.alibi: Home, all last night! A terribly dull account. I cling to its dullness.
merrin.report: Oh, I dread what you'll make of this. I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening.
merrin.challenged_report: Now I must defend my own eyes as well? Rowan, the tavern, yesterday evening. I saw them.

nisha.direction: Separates the contested premise from the rest; no deductions beyond the supplied account.
nisha.gift_refusal: I won't disclose my gift. What question does that leave you with?
nisha.alibi: I stayed home all last night. That is my account; it isn't independent confirmation.
nisha.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Keep the sighting separate from what it might mean.
nisha.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Which part do you dispute: the person, the place, or the time?

odette.direction: Literal independence with dry understatement; withholding approval rather than cross-examining.
odette.gift_refusal: My gift is staying private. I'm sure the question will survive unanswered.
odette.alibi: At home all last night. I appreciate that it's a terribly dull answer.
odette.report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. Make of it what you will.
odette.challenged_report: I saw Rowan at the tavern yesterday evening. I can't offer you a more agreeable recollection.
